items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta, full launch, alert expansion, affiliate use, and advertising. Woot documentation proves API access mechanics but not rights to store, derive, cache, publicly display, alert on, or monetize deal and price-history data. Human counsel is required for upstream rights, jurisdictional privacy treatment, and future affiliate or advertising use. Keep SearchWoot private and preview-only; keep outreach unsent pending counsel review and owner authorization.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks are closed and 4 remain open. No task is closed because direct evidence remains missing. Continue the consolidated read-only evidence bundle. Next evidence action: attach field-level rights, deployed data flow, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 configuration and retention, log fields, vendors, incident procedures, accuracy and freshness controls, and rollback evidence.

Data-use dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data is blocked because written permission and field-level rights are absent. User alert rules and sync results, GA4 analytics, and operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed. Ordinary reversible growth remains conditional when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior and preserves consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright and trademark, affiliate, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Public exposure and security-sensitive releases remain blocked where evidence is missing.

Keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. Continue only the existing readiness packets. Next evidence action: attach dated ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement-boundary, rollback, and explicit-blocker evidence for each property by 2026-09-30T17:00Z. Do not publish, deploy, alter DNS, configure analytics, monetize, spend, add dependencies, or create queue work.

Continue existing repair-or-close, deployed-work measurement, security evidence, finance reconciliation, private launch-gate, and parked-site readiness work only. Do not create duplicate requests, retry unchanged failures, add telemetry, spend, deploy, or expand monetization. Revenue remains limited to 2026-09-21 Amazon evidence of 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate unattributed commission; margin, ROI, forecasts, and causal lift remain unknown.
